claims.content: The system captures the details of voucher sales between the MISU sales team and Distributors to facilitate the distribution process and enable reporting.

goal.raw_text: The system captures the details of voucher sales between the MISU sales team and Distributors to facilitate the distribution process and enable reporting.

claims.content: VMU User
Distributor master records must exist in the system so that the VMU User can select a distributor during voucher distribution.
Salesman master records must exist in the system so that the VMU User can select a salesman during voucher distribution.
Voucher stock must be available in the system to allow automatic allocation of voucher numbers and batch numbers during distribution.
The VMU User initiates the process to record the distribution of vouchers to a distributor.

trigger.raw_text: The VMU User initiates the process to record the distribution of vouchers to a distributor.

claims.content: If the distributor or salesman name is not available in the system during voucher distribution, the VMU User can navigate quickly to the respective master screen to enter new details without closing the current distribution screen.
If the VMU User enters a future date for distribution, the system will perform a validation check and prevent the transaction from proceeding.
If the VMU User attempts to enter non-numeric data in the 'Required Qty' field during voucher distribution, the system will reject the entry as only numeric input is allowed.
The system allocates relevant vouchers with their specific voucher numbers and batch numbers from the available stock based on the quantity required by the distributor.
The system automatically calculates the Invoice Amount as the product of the number of vouchers sold and the wholesale price.
The system generates an auto-generated Distribution Invoice Number for the transaction.
The system displays the details of each allocated voucher, including Batch No, Voucher No, and Validity Date, in a grid format.
The captured distribution details enable the generation of reports such as Distributor-wise, Salesman-wise, and Batch No wise sales details.
